641:t_017:24.en:
$$アスカ$$
「The poles? You mean the South Pole and the North Pole!?」

641:t_017:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Something is coming out of the ground at the South Pole of $$蒼の地球$$!」

641:t_018:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「No way! Three of those monsters showed up!」

641:t_018:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「To think something like that was buried in Antarctica!」

641:t_018:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$エル・ミレニウム$$ was kept asleep until the day it would pass judgment on humanity.」

641:t_018:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「On the day your ancestors landed on the Moon, those three emissaries were sent to the poles.」

641:t_018:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「So the existence of those things is proof of your power... the power of humanity's administrators!」

641:t_018:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「And you guys get this one as a bonus, too!」

641:t_019:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A black $$アンゲロイ$$ showed up too!」

641:t_019:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Its name is $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$... The $$アンゲロイ$$ the $$サイデリアル$$ use are nothing but imitations of it.」

641:t_019:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「So those crystal monsters and the black $$アンゲロイ$$ are the $$御使い$$s' own direct forces!」

641:t_019:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As you know, that power is nothing compared to the weapons given to the $$サイデリアル$$.」

641:t_019:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Why are you explaining it with such a smug look, $$アウストラリス$$?」

641:t_019:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$アウストラリス$$. Seize the four $$スフィア$$s the Earth species possess and bring them back, and your sin will be forgiven.」

641:t_019:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I am not $$アウストラリス$$...」

641:t_019:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am the $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$!」

641:t_019:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We take that as rebellion against us.」

641:t_019:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That arrogance... Must I spell it out for you before you understand...?」

641:t_019:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am the $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! The power to destroy the fundamental calamity!」

641:t_019:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Ha ha ha! Thanks for all your hard work, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

641:t_019:12.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$立ち上がる射手$$ draws its power from defiance. Of course we realized that you, who hold that $$スフィア$$, only obeyed us on the surface.」

641:t_019:13.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And yet you let me do as I pleased. Was that the arrogance of being certain you'd win?」

641:t_020:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Wait, $$ヴィルダーク$$! If we combine your power and ours...」

641:t_020:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Don't rely on others! Fight with your own strength!」

641:t_020:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Sooner or later, I'll take your $$スフィア$$s. In order to destroy them...!」

641:t_021:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「So he's our enemy after all, huh!」

641:t_021:1.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「But he knows his place.」

641:t_021:2.en:
$$ズール$$
「That he cannot defeat them with his current power.」

641:t_021:3.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$御使い$$s. Today I only came to see your faces.」

641:t_021:4.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「The place of our battle is...」

641:t_021:5.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「That vast sea of stars.」

641:t_021:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「We'll settle it there! The True War, which has raged for 120 million years!」

641:t_022:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「A declaration of war! This is getting exciting!」

641:t_022:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But no matter how hard those people struggle, they cannot set foot in our universe.」

641:t_022:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then let us return. To our universe... the $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

641:t_023:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Those guys! Are we not even worth their notice!?」

641:t_023:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Just as $$ハーデス$$ said before, compared to a war between god and demon, god and god, our existence must be insignificant.」

641:t_023:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Making fools of us! Then we'll just smash the parting gift they left behind!」

641:t_023:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「So those crystal monsters are a system for destroying any humanity that doesn't obey their will...!」

641:t_023:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can't even tell if we could beat one of them, and there are three...!」

641:t_023:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We have no choice but to do it...!」

641:t_023:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Dammit! This is no time to be setting sail anymore, is it!?」

641:t_023:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Just now, the $$大統領$$'s approval came through.」

641:t_023:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「So the 'if the worst happens' moment has already arrived, huh...」

641:t_023:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, hold the line for three minutes! To keep them from reaching Earth, we have to stop them here!」

641:t_023:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If we can't defeat the enemy in those three minutes...」

641:t_023:13.en:
$$タケル$$
「Focus on nothing but fighting right now! Otherwise we'll be taken down...!」

641:t_023:14.en:
$$桂$$
「A journey of hope, and it turns into a battlefield of despair just like that!」

641:t_023:15.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But we have no choice! If we stop moving forward here, nothing will change!」

641:t_024:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「We managed to win somehow, but...」

641:t_024:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What are we gonna do, man!? If another one of these shows up after we head off to the galaxy, humanity is seriously finished!」

641:t_024:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We'll think about that later!」

641:t_025:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even if we beat these guys here, if another one of these shows up after we head off to the galaxy, humanity is seriously finished!」

641:t_025:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We'll think about that later!」

641:t_026:0.en:
$$ノイン$$
「At this rate, it's not just the departure... we could be wiped out!」

641:t_026:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But if we're broken through here, Earth...!」

641:t_026:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$トライア$$, the activation of $$スヴェル$$ has been executed on the $$地球連邦$$ $$大統領$$'s order.」

641:t_026:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「As you just heard, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

641:t_026:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Right...! All ships, rally around the $$バスターマシン$$! All units, follow!」

641:t_026:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「The enemy's still here! And yet...!」

641:t_026:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're saying we abandon Earth and set sail!?」

641:t_027:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$御使い$$s' forces are heading for Earth...!」

641:t_027:1.en:
$$シン$$
「At this rate they'll break through the atmosphere!」

641:t_027:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$霊子吸収システム$$ of each $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ and of $$ラース・バビロン$$ is operating normally!」

641:t_027:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「Deployment of the Earth Defense Dimensional Barrier '$$スヴェル$$' confirmed!」

641:t_028:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So that's... the Earth Defense Dimensional Barrier...!」

kept_omissions: 641:t_020:1: Vildark's 頼るな - the object (rely on whom) is unstated; rendered 'Don't rely on others!' (could be 'on me').
641:t_021:2: Xul's 奴等 = 'them' (the Messengers/Angels), left as pronoun.
641:t_020:3: Vildark's 奴等 (whom he will destroy with the Spheres) kept as 'them'.
641:t_026:2: AG's トライア様 -> bare $$トライア$$ (honorific dropped).
uncertain: 641:t_018:2: $$エル・ミレニウム$$ used as the name of the crystal monsters (Doctrine calls them the three emissaries); 'was kept asleep' with singular verb for the class name.
641:t_018:5 / t_019:2-3: crystal monsters rendered 'crystal monsters' per dlg_2091_05; 使者 = 'emissaries'.
641:t_023:10: Traia's 万一の時 rendered as 'if the worst happens' moment.
641:t_019:1/3 and t_019:12: Vildark's Japanese is prosaic; 'As you know' added by 知っての通り.
641:t_017:24: 極点 rendered 'the poles' (Asuka asks whether it means South/North Pole).
